message: NO TEACHER REVIEW DECISIONS EXIST FOR THE RESEARCH CORPUS
provenance_note: A researcher decision is never reported as teacher validation. Only reviewer roles teacher or supervisor count as such.
rate_note: Rates are computed over reviewed suggestions only. They are null when nothing has been reviewed, rather than 0.0, because 0.0 would read as a finding.
review_file_note: corpus_teacher_reviews.csv holds decisions about the frozen research corpus. teacher_reviews.csv is the separate runtime app's log and is reported separately, not merged.
runtime_note: Runtime reviews come from the separate runtime analysis app and are not decisions about the frozen research corpus. They are reported here only so no real human decision goes unrecorded.
significance_tests_note: No significance tests. Sample size and design do not support inferential claims.
